name: isa-bank-transfer-received
subject: ISA transfer complete
previewText: The money from your ISA transfer is available in your Abundance account

fields.heading: ISA transfer complete
fields.body:
Hello {first_name},

We’ve received the money for your ISA transfer of {amount} from {existing_isa_manager} and it is now available in your IF ISA to invest.

You can choose to invest into any of our open investments or by purchasing a past investment on the marketplace by logging into your Abundance account.
